_comment: Extracted from MMPL Private Limited's signed audited financial statements (Singhi & Co., except FY2019-20/2020-21 audited by Kapoor Mehrotra & Associates). All figures in Rs. Lakhs unless noted. 'netWorthConvention' = Equity Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Securities Premium (matches the exact methodology used in the real signed Net Worth Certificate for FY2024-25, cross-verified against Net Worth Certificate_001.pdf: 164.17 + 42,346.48 + 6,373.28 = 48,883.93, exact match). FY2022-23 and FY2021-22 have two bases - see 'basis' field: figures from FY2023-24 onward are Ind AS; FY2022-23's own filed statement (basis: 'IGAAP-as-filed') used pre-Ind-AS Schedule III format and does not net-worth-convention-match the Ind-AS-restated comparative shown in later filings (basis: 'IndAS-restated'). Use IndAS-restated figures for consistency with later years unless a specific old filing is being referenced. UPDATE THIS FILE each year once the new audited financial statements are signed - do not hardcode these figures into gemini-client.js/openrouter-client.js.

2024-25.netWorthConventionVerified: Matches real signed Net Worth Certificate_001.pdf exactly, confirmed 2026-09-05

alternateBasis.note: As-filed figures differ from the Ind-AS-restated comparative above; do not mix the two bases in one certificate.
